mpower.name: Parkinson Disease Mobile Data Study (mPower)
mpower.access_requirements: Synapse user registration, human subjects research ethics training, and data access request

labels.summary: Self-reported diagnosis (PD, Control) and medication timing (pre/post dose)

mpower.missing_data: High longitudinal participant attrition; missing task sessions
mpower.limitations: Self-reported diagnostic status; variable smartphone sensor quality; high noise
mpower.intended_use: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining for mobile digital biomarkers

oct500.name: OCT500 Retinal Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset
oct500.source: Nanjing University of Science and Technology / IEEE DataPort
oct500.access_requirements: Academic email registration and non-commercial end-user agreement

labels.summary: Ophthalmic pathology labels (AMD, DR, CNV, Normal) and 6-layer retinal segmentations; NO PD LABELS

oct500.missing_data: Low SNR frames in deeper choroidal scans
oct500.limitations: Contains retinal disease labels (AMD, DR, CNV) but NO Parkinson's disease labels; small sample size (N=500)
oct500.intended_use: Pretraining 3D OCT layer segmentation and retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) encoder models

physionet_gait.name: Gait in Parkinson's Disease Dataset
physionet_gait.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) v1.0

labels.summary: Binary PD vs Control diagnosis, Hoehn & Yahr staging, UPDRS motor scores

physionet_gait.missing_data: Minimal frame loss across 2-minute steady walking recordings
physionet_gait.limitations: Single-modality gait force time-series; recorded under controlled laboratory conditions; no non-motor labels
physionet_gait.intended_use: Modality-specific pretraining and feature extraction evaluation for the gait/motor branch

ppmi.name: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative
ppmi.source: Michael J. Fox Foundation / LONI Image Data Archive
ppmi.access_requirements: Account registration, research plan submission, and signed PPMI Data Use Agreement (DUA)

labels.summary: Clinical diagnosis: PD, Prodromal (RBD/Hyposmia), Healthy Control, SWEDD

ppmi.missing_data: Longitudinal attrition, optional sub-study non-completion, visit window missingness
ppmi.limitations: Complex schema changes across annual data releases; restricted access for specific bio-assays (e.g. SAA)
ppmi.intended_use: Primary dataset for prototype training, multimodal fusion development, and longitudinal validation

predict_pd.name: PREDICT-PD Study Cohort
predict_pd.source: Queen Mary University of London (QMUL) / University College London (UCL)
predict_pd.access_requirements: Formal collaboration application to study PIs (predictpd@qmul.ac.uk) and institutional ethics committee approval

labels.summary: Predicted PD risk algorithm tier (High / Intermediate / Low) and longitudinal motor conversion

predict_pd.missing_data: Self-administered online questionnaire missingness; longitudinal drop-off
predict_pd.limitations: Not available for open public download; keyboard tapping is less precise than clinical force sensors
predict_pd.intended_use: External validation dataset for prodromal risk stratification and non-motor algorithm testing

retinal_fundus_pretraining.name: Retinal Fundus Pretraining Corpus (EyePACS / Messidor-2 / DRIVE / APTOS)
retinal_fundus_pretraining.access_requirements: Kaggle user registration and competition terms agreement

labels.summary: Diabetic retinopathy severity grades (0-4) and vessel segmentation masks; NO PD LABELS

retinal_fundus_pretraining.missing_data: Non-uniform image sizing, illumination gradients, media opacities
retinal_fundus_pretraining.limitations: Strictly pretraining only; contains diabetic retinopathy and normal eye images but NO Parkinson's clinical labels
retinal_fundus_pretraining.intended_use: Pretraining CNN / Vision Transformer backbones for retinal vessel segmentation and feature representation

synthetic_fixture.name: MPF-PD Synthetic Test Fixture

labels.summary: Synthetic integer labels (0=Control, 1=Prodromal, 2=PD); ZERO clinical validity

synthetic_fixture.missing_data: Controlled synthetic missingness (10% missing values per column)
synthetic_fixture.limitations: Purely synthetic test fixture; contains zero physiological reality or real patient evidence
synthetic_fixture.intended_use: Unit testing, continuous integration, and pipeline validation

uci_voice.name: UCI Parkinson's Telemonitoring Dataset
uci_voice.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository / University of Oxford
uci_voice.missing_data: Low missingness within acoustic features; uneven recording intervals per patient
uci_voice.limitations: Small subject count (N=42); lacks healthy control group; single modality (voice only)
uci_voice.intended_use: Modality-specific representation learning and regression target prediction for the speech/voice branch
